run_train_conformal: run the TrainConformal class to train a model with smooth conformal prediction and calibration
compute_loss_and_error_with_calibration: compute conformal loss with prediction and calibration on a split batch using smooth calibration
select_smooth_calibrate: select smooth confidence set prediction and calibration functions for training and testing
get_train_fns: get separate training and test loss functions for conformal training with JIT compilation
select_smooth_calibrate_threshold: select a smooth calibration method using threshold, threshold_p, threshold_logp, or aps approaches
